name: catgrid
description: A seeded one-cat-per-row, column and region logic grid (the Queens / Star Battle family, after the operator's Meowdoku). Every board comes from a seed and has exactly one answer; every move is a pure function of the state it is played on. Hints are free once per board and earned by Jeles trivia; Gerald's napkin words hide under some boards. Plays on the-table as a GameSession.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: A game's inputs (seed, size, moves) and outcome, so it replays byte for byte
data_streams.description: Written only through the injected SOIL seam; with no backend nothing is written

data_streams.purpose: Napkin words found, so a found Easter egg stays found
data_streams.description: The word, and the seed and cell it was found on

data_streams.purpose: Which Jeles questions were asked and answered
data_streams.description: The Jeles pair id and the answer given; nothing about who answered

network: none. Stdlib only, no sockets; trivia and napkin words are read from files beside it.
